proposals.title: Soften data-layer.md Esri feature-service equivalence claim
proposals.summary: items/data-layer.md summary still says The native equivalent of an Esri feature service. Same oversell class as the now-fixed form.md Survey123 line. Soften to PostGIS-backed feature tables with OGC / public API surfaces, and a short What this is not note (not a hosted feature service drop-in, not ArcGIS Server).
proposals.rationale: Playbook ethos: honest about what we are not. Form honesty (#453) already set the pattern; data-layer is the next frontmatter that still claims native equivalent.
proposals.risk: Docs-only. Keep PostGIS / OGC Features / public mirrors discoverable. Do not invent ArcGIS FeatureServer parity. CHANGELOG Documentation note; skip What's new unless the help card blurb changes enough to notice.
proposals.ethosFit: Honest about not being ArcGIS Online / ArcGIS Server. Prefer OGC / PostGIS shapes.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Rewrite data-layer.md summary + short honesty blurb; CHANGELOG docs note; skip What's new.

proposals.title: Tighter throttle on Public layer filtered-extent
proposals.summary: PublicController GET .../layers/:layerId/filtered-extent is @Public with only global 300/min. Anonymous zoom-to-filter can run PostGIS extent work with where/via/asOf. Add @Throttle 60/min matching features-page / aggregate / Records.
proposals.rationale: List/compute class sibling of already-queued aggregate and features mirrors. Low severity, no product call, same SEC-* pattern.
proposals.risk: Dashboards that hammer filtered-extent on pan may hit 60/min. Prefer 60; leave MVT and ACL unchanged. Document in CHANGELOG Security + api.md rate note; skip What's new.
proposals.ethosFit: Self-hosted Public DoS hardening without pricing or Keycloak defaults.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Add @Throttle 60/min on layerFilteredExtent; CHANGELOG Security + api.md Public rate note; skip What's new.

proposals.title: Tighter throttle on Public CSW GetCapabilities / GetRecords
proposals.summary: PublicCswController GET /public/csw is @Public with only global 300/min. GetRecords walks public items (start/max up to 200) for harvesters. Add @Throttle 60/min on the controller or dispatch method matching Records list.
proposals.rationale: Catalogue harvest endpoint without a tighter Nest budget. Same Public list class as Records / STAC / Features collections.
proposals.risk: Aggressive CSW harvesters may need to back off. Prefer 60; keep maxrecords clamp (200) and XML shape unchanged. CHANGELOG Security + api.md / CSW help note; skip What's new.
proposals.ethosFit: OGC-compatible catalogue surface with honest rate limits. Self-hosted hardening.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Add @Throttle 60/min on CSW dispatch; CHANGELOG Security + short api.md note; skip What's new.

proposals.title: Tighter throttle on Public DCAT catalog.json
proposals.summary: PublicController GET catalog.json is @Public with only global 300/min and runs an unbounded findMany of every public item for the org. Add @Throttle 60/min (optionally also a soft row cap later; this PR is throttle-only).
proposals.rationale: Anonymous DCAT dump is a catalogue scan class endpoint. Cheaper than feature streams but still unbounded list work per call.
proposals.risk: Open-data harvesters polling often may hit 60/min. Prefer 60; do not change DCAT shape in this PR. CHANGELOG Security + api.md; skip What's new. Row-cap is a separate product-ish follow-up if needed.
proposals.ethosFit: Open standards (DCAT) with Public DoS budget. No seat pricing.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Add @Throttle 60/min on catalog(); CHANGELOG Security + api.md; skip What's new.
